heart-press.label: Heart Press
heart-press.how: Press a flat palm to your chest and let your eyes close for a beat.

reach-to-lens.label: Reach to Lens
reach-to-lens.how: Reach one open hand slowly toward the lens at chest height, fingers soft.

pull-back.label: Pull Back
pull-back.how: Close the hand softly and draw it back to your chest.

jaw-trace.label: Jaw Trace
jaw-trace.how: Trace your fingertips from your ear along your jaw and stop before your chin.

backbeat-snaps.label: Backbeat Snaps
backbeat-snaps.how: Snap softly on beats 2 and 4, small, at chest height and out to the side.

palm-roll.label: Palm Roll
palm-roll.how: Turn one hand at chest height slowly from palm up to palm down, like stirring honey.

adlib-wave.label: Ad-lib Wave
adlib-wave.how: Raise one open hand to head height, out to the side, and sway it slowly side to side.

hair-comb.label: Hair Comb
hair-comb.how: Rake your fingers back through your hair from the temple, elbow out, head tilted.

come-here.label: Come Here
come-here.how: Hold one hand out at chest height and slowly curl a finger toward yourself.

loop-circle.label: The Loop
loop-circle.how: Draw one slow, big circle in front of your chest with one finger.

frame-face.label: Frame the Face
frame-face.how: Open both hands beside your cheeks like a picture frame, then let them fall.

shoulder-roll.label: Shoulder Roll
shoulder-roll.how: Roll one shoulder up, back and down, slowly.

body-roll.label: Body Roll
body-roll.how: Roll a slow, small wave from your chest down to your hips.

hair-flip.label: Hair Flip
hair-flip.how: Turn your head away and back as one shoulder lifts, so your hair swings.

sway.label: Sway
sway.how: Shift your weight left on beat 1 and right on beat 3, small and smooth.

ooh-face.label: Ooh Face
ooh-face.how: Round your lips into a soft “ooh” and lift your brows a little.

turn-left.label: Face Left
turn-left.how: Turn a quarter to your left, slowly, and hold still.

turn-back.label: Show Your Back
turn-back.how: Keep turning the same way until your back is to the lens, and hold.

turn-right.label: Face Right
turn-right.how: Keep turning the same way, a quarter more, and hold.

turn-front.label: Face Front
turn-front.how: Finish the turn back to the lens, and hold.

look-back.label: Look Back
look-back.how: Turn half away, then look back at the lens slowly over your shoulder.

takes.title: Hero take
takes.brief: Your main take: the whole song, sung to the lens. Soft, close, a little seductive. Hit each move as its card lands, then let your hands rest.

Warm light in front, about 45° to one side; no window behind you
Camera at eye level, landscape, an arm's length away
Head to waist in frame
Both hands in frame; a free hand rests at your stomach
Hands off your mouth while you sing
Something fitted, in a solid color

takes.title: Turnaround
takes.brief: A slow 360 in quarter turns, about 2 seconds each, then one slow look back over your shoulder. This shows the AI what you look like from every side.
setup: Step back until your hands show in the frame
Clear a little space to turn in place

takes.title: Hand library
takes.brief: Your hand library: every house move once, slow and clear, about 2 seconds each. These are the shapes the AI copies.
